# .NET Object To Variant.vi

![.NET Object To Variant.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/NET-07.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Converts a .NET Framework object reference to a LabVIEW variant while retaining the error connector.

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.
